interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Vegetation Management

interventions.description: Regular removal of illegally dumped items like mattresses and consistent trash collection to keep the walkway clear.

interventions.title: Sanitation and Maintenance
interventions.description: Regular removal of debris and trash to clear walking paths and improve the environment.

interventions.title: Street Trees
